What to understand at MT15

Stone charging
The process that prepares Infinity Stones for their effects. Finding and unlocking them does not mean charging is finished.
Infinity Power
A benefit associated with regional Infinity records that supports stone charging, according to the supplied Infinity reference.
Exotic Refinements
Permanent improvements that can support endgame charging. Compare their current costs and effects before spending.

Your next objectives

  • There is no MT16 route in this MT0–15 guide. Your next objective is the final-boss preparation and whatever endgame goals you choose.
  • Inspect the current final-boss entry conditions and relevant insurance upgrades before committing resources.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Read the boss-entry condition

    The community references identifies Thorus as the final boss and describes activating all Infinity Stones through the special toggle perk near the bottom of the Infinity perk list for the first fight. Confirm the current control and prerequisites in your game; reaching MT15 alone is not the entire entry process. [S02] [S09]

  2. Finish charging preparation

    Review which stone is slowing the setup and what currently determines its charging time. Keep collection, unlocking, activation and charging as separate checklist items so you do not repeatedly solve a condition already complete. [S09]

  3. Improve regional Infinity records

    Continue building stronger records where your blueprint can progress efficiently. The supplied source connects these records to Infinity Power and faster charging. Favor improvements you can obtain reliably before forcing an extremely expensive push for a small benefit. [S09]

  4. Compare permanent charging investments

    Review Exotic Refinements and the available duration reductions. The supplied Infinity guidance favors considering duration reductions once basic upgrades are established. Evaluate the benefit against your actual charging wait instead of assuming every linear bonus deserves another purchase. [S09]

  5. Prepare resources and learn from attempts

    Read the relevant insurance upgrades and fight controls. After an attempt, identify the specific mechanic or resource that limited it and prepare that part before retrying. This page provides endgame preparation, not an independently tested boss combat script or a guarantee of a first-attempt victory. [S09]

If you are stuck

I reached MT15 but cannot start the fight

Check the stone activation and entry conditions rather than looking for another military promotion.

Most of my time is spent waiting for stones

Compare regional record improvements and permanent charging upgrades. Diagnose the charging bottleneck separately from tower combat strength.

Ready to move on?

  • The current boss-entry conditions are understood and satisfied.
  • You have checked stone states, charging and the relevant resource costs.
Where to go next

Return to earlier tier guides for the systems you want to improve, or use the source library for more specialized routes. Older imported blueprints and scripts still need checking against your version. [S02] [S09]
